d:
The Spurs defeated the Warriors, 123-85 tonight in San Antonio. Stephon Castle contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 6 assists 5 rebounds and 5 three pointers, with Keldon Johnson of the Spurs adding an additional 18 points (6-11 FG, 2-6 3P) in the game. LJ Cryer finished with a team-high 20 points along with 6 assists for the Warriors in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 11-2 with the win, while the Warriors fall to 8-5 for the season.
